name: Balderdash
summary: Bluffing party game where players invent fake definitions for obscure words and vote for the real one.
rules_text: One player is the Dasher each round. Dasher draws a card and reads a question from a category such as Weird Words, People, Initials, Movies or Laws. Other players secretly write a plausible fake answer to bluff others. Dasher writes the true answer. All answers are shuffled and read aloud. Each non-Dasher then votes clockwise for the answer they think is real, cannot score for voting own. Scoring: 1 point per vote your bluff receives, 2 points for guessing the true answer, 3 points to Dasher if no one guesses true, 3 bonus points if your bluff is essentially the true answer. Advance on board by points earned. Dasher rotates left. First to Finish wins.
rating_reason: Classic bluffing definitions game fits text and voting.
